title: the policy set as an ordinary user with no home folder
note: basis 'shown' means shown in the card's container on master ecbb1f89, as nobody (uid 65534, passwd home /nonexistent) under env -i in its own copy, with CI's umask, coverage, xdist and long test root, and as root; CI itself was not run

findings.claim: the box-install first-run tests (test_poc_stops_h94 _firstrun) let the script keep the one-time code in the runner's real passwd home: as nobody (no home) the script rightly stopped and 9 tests failed, and as root each run wrote then removed /root/trialbox-firstrun-code (a synthetic marker there was deleted); a stand-in getent now names a home under tmp_path, no product change and no assertion changed

test_tools_keys_refuses_a_folder_owned_by_another_user made uid 65534 the folder's other owner, which is nobody's own uid, so as nobody tools.keys rightly accepted the folder (DID NOT RAISE); the test now shows tools.keys another runner uid only when the runner is 65534, the assertion unchanged

test_cloud_run.py::test_a_part_records_its_run_and_a_new_run_runs_it_again found its screenshot browser only through the caller's browsers-path variable or the home cache, so under env -i it failed as nobody and as root (0/1 screenshots); the test's own environment now gets the preinstalled browser folder when it exists (the integrator's go 7143979475), assertions unchanged

the skip of test_cloud_run.py::test_a_part_records_its_run_and_a_new_run_runs_it_again (lines 51-54) checks only for the node driver, never for a browser it can launch, so a host with the driver and no findable browser fails the test instead of skipping it; the skip is unchanged (the external reviewer's note 7143959133)
